name: Pope John XXIII
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 1958 to 1963
contribution: Head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of Vatican City from 28 October 1958 until his death on 3 June 1963.

checks.lead: Pope John XXIII (born Angelo Giuseppe Roncalli;  25 November 1881 – 3 June 1963) was head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of Vatican City from 28 October 1958 until his death on 3 June 1963.
